cut: Coxon, DRAFT v1 (20 Oct 2026) — one question: should you ask a chatbot when to vote?
argument: Don't ask a chatbot when to vote: in a September study, 29% of chatbot voting answers were incomplete, wrong or out of date, and one said 4 November, a Wednesday. Ask your election office.
syntax: '/' breaks a line, [word] is the pop word; in Japanese a space marks a reveal segment and is never drawn

text.en: Should you ask a chatbot / [when to vote]?
text.ja: チャットボットに / [投票日を] 聞いて いい？

captions.source: The film's question. Peg: NPR, 'People are asking ChatGPT to help them decide how to vote in the midterms', 5 Oct 2026 (voters use chatbots for ballot research). Not quoted.

text.en: In a September study, [29%] of / chatbot answers on voting were / incomplete, wrong or outdated.
text.fi: Syyskuun tutkimuksessa [29 %] / chatbottien vaalivastauksista / oli puutteellisia, virheellisiä / tai vanhentuneita.
text.ja: 9月の 調査では、 チャットボットの / 投票に 関する 回答の [29%]が / 不完全、 誤り、 または 古かった。

captions.source: Institute for Strategic Dialogue, 'Chatbots and the Ballot Box', published 3 Sep 2026: 29% of six chatbots' answers to basic English voting prompts were incomplete, inaccurate or outdated (The Hill, NBC News, Latin Times, Political Wire; the PDF itself could not be opened here). The tests ran in June, so 'a September study', never 'test'. Never 'lie': the 29% includes incomplete answers.

text.en: One chatbot even got / [Election Day] wrong.
text.ja: ある チャットボットは / [投票日] まで 間違えた。

captions.source: ISD (as above): one of the six chatbots named 4 November 2026 as Election Day, in two responses (NBC News and The Hill summaries of the report). The chatbot is not named, on screen or here.

text.ja: 投票日は / 11月3日の [火曜日]。

captions.source: 2 U.S.C. §7: the Tuesday after the first Monday in November. 3 Nov 2026 is a Tuesday (computed, 20 Oct 2026).

text.en: One chatbot said / November fourth. / [That's a Wednesday].
text.fi: Yksi chatbot sanoi / 4. marraskuuta. / [Se on keskiviikko].
text.ja: ある チャットボットは / 11月4日だと 答えた。 / [それは 水曜日]。

captions.source: The station's line, over its own image: 4 Nov 2026 is a Wednesday (computed, 20 Oct 2026). The picture then points to the real source, the local election office.

ask.ja: 地元の|選挙管理委員会へ

sticker.why: the American polling-place sticker, an artefact: English in every master, the caption carries the meaning

gym.why: the lettering over a US school gym's doors: an artefact, English in every master

post.en: Should you ask a chatbot when to vote? In a September study by the Institute for Strategic Dialogue, 29% of chatbot answers to basic voting questions were incomplete, wrong or outdated. One chatbot gave Election Day as November 4. It's Tuesday, November 3. Ask your local election office. #Midterms #AI
post.fi: Kannattaako chatbotilta kysyä, milloin äänestää? Institute for Strategic Dialoguen syyskuisessa tutkimuksessa 29 % chatbottien vastauksista perusäänestyskysymyksiin oli puutteellisia, virheellisiä tai vanhentuneita. Yksi chatbot ilmoitti vaalipäiväksi 4. marraskuuta. Se on tiistai 3. marraskuuta. Kysy omalta vaaliviranomaiselta.
post.ja: 投票日をチャットボットに聞いていい？ Institute for Strategic Dialogueの9月の調査では、投票の基本的な質問への回答の29%が不完全・誤り・古い情報だった。あるチャットボットは投票日を11月4日と答えた。正しくは11月3日（火）。地元の選挙管理委員会に確認を。
